name_reason: Has the data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle core table convention); descriptor accurately reflects purpose (special-attack / class-promotion cinematic parallax background layers) and the plural 'layers' reflects the array data type. The [3] dimension is a legitimate semantic (3 parallax sub-layers cycled as frame % 3) carried in the declaration/type, not the name; the name itself carries no Ghidra address residue. Verified against dword[3] type, both READ/WRITE xrefs, and the cycling readers indexing [i % 3].
purpose: 3-element heap-pointer array (uint32[3]) caching three parallax background sub-layers loaded from BG.DAT[0..2], used by the special-attack and class-promotion full-screen combat cinematics.
logic_summary: Each writer (fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic in the split-screen path, fd2_execute_special_attack_skill, fd2_play_spell_cast_cinematic) zeroes all three slots then stores the malloc-backed result of fd2_load_dat_resource(BG.DAT path 0x52381, prev, n) for n=0,1,2 into [0]/[1]/[2]. The BG zoom/scroll readers (fd2_animate_bg_zoom_transition_in, fd2_cycle_sprite_anim_with_bg_frames) cycle through the trio via [frame_iter % 3] / [(iter+2) % 3] / [(bg_variant_idx+1) % 3] to produce a parallax backdrop, RLE-blitting the selected layer each frame. On cleanup each writer frees all three slots. A real C array is emitted so ascending adjacency is guaranteed (Watcom lays separate BSS/COMDEF scalars in reverse definition order, which would invert slots and feed garbage pointers to the RLE blitter).
datatype: uint32[3] (dword[3], 12 bytes) -- array of 3 heap pointers
element_semantics: Each element is a 32-bit far/flat heap pointer to one malloc-backed RLE background sub-layer loaded from BG.DAT entry n (slot 0 @ 0x5410B = BG.DAT[0], slot 1 @ 0x5410F = BG.DAT[1], slot 2 @ 0x54113 = BG.DAT[2]); cycled modulo 3 during the parallax scroll.
notes: Verified via Ghidra: data type dword[3] (USER_DEFINED primary symbol); memory all-zero (BSS, .object2); xrefs show WRITE+READ from 5 functions (fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic, fd2_execute_special_attack_skill, fd2_play_spell_cast_cinematic, fd2_animate_bg_zoom_transition_in, fd2_cycle_sprite_anim_with_bg_frames) -> game writes it => not const. src definition comment (anicine.c lines 64-81) and globals.h decl comment (line ~150-158) already accurate, precise, ASCII -> comment_verdict=keep.
